events.title: Haunted Paws - End of Playtest
events.summary: Today we officially close our playtest. If you received access earlier, you were able to play it up until today. From now on, the playtest will no longer be available. Thank you to everyone who tried our playtest. It was rough in some places, but that helped us clearly see what needs improvement before release. events.title: Online Delayed + Playtest Extended
events.summary: We’re currently experiencing some issues with our online multiplayer. Since we have a huge number of playtesters (almost 300,000!), we want to make sure you get the smoothest, most bug-free experience possible. Because of that, we’re delaying the multiplayer release until next week.To make up for the delay, we’re also extending the Playtest period so you can enjoy the game for longer!Thank you all so much for playing, sharing feedback, and supporting us.
